audienceActivation.mappingGuidance:
Pinterest Customer Lists accept three identifier columns. Use these names verbatim as `to`; they are what get_audience_destination_schema returns in fields[].name.
- EMAIL — the user's email address.
- MAID — a mobile advertising ID (AAID on Android; IDFA only where Pinterest's policy allows it).
- PHONE — the user's phone number.

Map as many as you have: Pinterest matches a user if any column in the row matches, so a row carrying several identifiers has a higher match rate than any one alone.

Phone numbers must include the country code (for example 13125550100 for a US number); formatting characters are removed before hashing.

Hashing: with isHashRequired true (the default) send RAW warehouse values and the integration normalizes and SHA-256 hashes them. With isHashRequired false, every value must already be the SHA-256 hex digest of the lowercased, trimmed email, or of the digits-only phone number including country code; unhashed values are rejected or fail to match.

Don't send IDFA collected from iOS app or website activity — Pinterest's policy forbids it.

Pinterest needs at least 100 matched users and 48–72 hours before an audience can be targeted.

AD ACCOUNT: the ad account id is not discoverable through these operations. An agent MUST have `adAccountId` set on the destination config before calling listAudiences or setup; ask the user for it rather than guessing.
